description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for timezone offsets, verifying if a given input falls within valid timezone offset bounds (-12.00 to 14.00).

classes.name: TimezoneOffset
classes.description: A class representing a validation rule for verifying if a timezone offset value is within the valid global range (-12.00 to 14.00).

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the given input representing a timezone offset is numeric and falls within the permitted range.
